title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
jobDescription: As a System Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, configuring, and delivering software solutions for metering systems projects. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution—from design through testing and commissioning—aligned with customer requirements and organizational standards. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to impactful industrial measurement solutions while building expertise in automation technologies. n This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Design, configure, and test SCADA/HMI systems using platforms such as Movicon , CIMPLICITY, and i FIX Develop and maintain reporting systems, including periodic and event-based reports, using SQL and scripting tools Configure and test communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC, and Ethernet-based systems Develop PLC programs using structured logic, function block diagrams, or ladder logic Collaborate with electrical and instrumentation teams to ensure integration across project deliverables Prepare and maintain technical documentation including design specifications, control logic, and test reports Perform system simulations, identify faults, and recommend effective technical solutions Support customer engagement activities, including system demonstrations and technical discussions Work with PLC/SCADA platforms such as ABB, Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Schneider Contribute to testing setups and continuously identify opportunities to improve quality and efficiency Share knowledge and best practices within the team to support continuous learning Who You Are: You build strong, collaborative relationships and work effectively across teams to achieve shared goals. You approach challenges with curiosity and use sound judgment to identify practical solutions. You communicate clearly and tailor your message to your audience, ensuring understanding and alignment. You continuously seek opportunities to learn, adapt, and improve, demonstrating accountability and a commitment to delivering quality outcomes. For This Role, You Will Need: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Instrumentation, Electronics, or a related field Hands-on experience with SCADA, PLC, and HMI systems Understanding of industrial communication protocols and automation systems Ability to manage tasks independently while meeting timelines and quality expectations Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal) Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: Experience working with metering systems (liquid or gas), including custody transfer applications Familiarity with flow computers such as S600+, OMNI, or equivalents Knowledge of metering standards such as AGA-7, AGA-8, or API Experience with batching systems and loading/unloading controllers Exposure to database management and scripting for SCADA systems Understanding of liquid proving, gas meter verification, and related processes Ability to contribute ideas for improving testing processes and system design Our Culture and Commitment To You: At Emerson, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and supported in their growth journey. title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
jobDescription: If you are a Senior Mechanical Engineering professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting role for you. In this position, you will contribute to the design and engineering of advanced metrology, blending, and transfer systems. title: Engineering Change Analyst 1
jobDescription: If you are an Engineer looking for an opportunity to grow on a global platform, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you in our Project Management Organization! Be a member of Centre of Excellence (COE) Customer Care team and own the responsibility of post order documentation for project orders by collaborating with various factories globally to meet the committed due dates as agreed in the EDDI (Emerson Document Deliverable Index) by collecting project documents, reviewing, ensuring proper storage, easy retrieval, maintain database, track revisions and ensure compliance with organizational procedures and industry standards. Actively participate in project kick-off meetings to understand customer documentation requirements. Maintain document status in EDDI and Vendor Document Register Lists (VDRL). Prepare and submit Manufacturing Record Books (MRB) or final data books, ensuring alignment with approved indices and supporting milestone payment processes. Promote a culture of safety by adhering to Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) policies, reporting risks, and participating in safety initiatives. Who You Are: You are action-oriented, taking initiative and following through on commitments with a sense of urgency. You communicate effectively across global teams, adapting your style to different audiences and ensuring clarity in both written and verbal interactions. You collaborate openly, building partnerships with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve shared goals. You are customer-focused, consistently striving to meet expectations and deliver high-quality outcomes. You plan and align your work effectively, ensuring priorities are managed and processes are optimized for efficiency. For This Role, You Will Need: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage confidently with global stakeholders. Proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, and similar). Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills with close attention to detail. Technical literacy and the ability to understand and review engineering-related documents. Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate effectively. Confidence to handle complex situations and maintain progress under pressure. Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: Exposure to document management systems or PLM tools (e.g., Windchill or similar platforms). Experience working in global project environments or cross-cultural teams. Familiarity with project documentation processes, including MRB or final documentation deliverables. Understanding of engineering or manufacturing documentation standards. Prior experience in customer-facing roles or coordination-intensive positions. Our Culture and Commitment To You: At Emerson, we prioritize a people-first culture that values inclusion, collaboration, and continuous growth. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed. You will have access to learning opportunities, global exposure, and a supportive environment that encourages innovation and ownership. We promote work-life balance, recognize contributions, and foster a culture where safety and well-being come first.

title: Lead Design Engineer - Bus Work & Layout
jobDescription: Lead Design Engineer – Bus Work & Layout will lead high-current bus work and mechanical layout design for generator excitation systems or relevant electrical power systems, typically in the 5,000 A to 10,000 A range. The role requires proven Auto CAD or relevant CAD experience, mandatory hands-on 3D design capability, and strong ownership of accurate bus work routing, clearances, fitment, manufacturability, and manufacturing quality support. Proven Autodesk Inventor experience will be a strong differentiator. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and concept design to hardware/software engineering, simulation, testing, and commissioning. Project Engineering: Lead project engineering for high-current generator excitation systems or relevant electrical power systems, from requirements review and concept development through detailed design, manufacturing support, FAT, installation, and commissioning. Develop accurate mechanical layouts for high-current applications, typically in the 5,000 A to 10,000 A range, using Auto CAD and relevant 3D design tools. Lead complete bus work design for high-current systems, including routing, dimensions, clearances, creepage, support locations, bend details, joint details, thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, accessibility, and manufacturability. Create and review general arrangement drawings, cabinet layouts, bus bar drawings, fabrication details, assembly drawings, BOMs, wiring interfaces, and manufacturing documentation with a high level of accuracy. Coordinate closely with electrical design, manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and system integrators to ensure the mechanical layout and bus work design are practical, safe, manufacturable, and compliant with project requirements. Support manufacturing quality processes, including design-for-manufacturing reviews, drawing release checks, assembly inspections, dimensional verification, test documentation, nonconformance resolution, and corrective actions. Apply 3D design practices to validate fitment, accessibility, clearances, cable routing, cooling paths, equipment installation, and serviceability before manufacturing release. Manage complete technical execution for assigned high-current bus work and layout design scope, including schedule, deliverables, design reviews, manufacturing readiness, risk mitigation, and customer or stakeholder clarifications. Field Services: Support site execution and installation planning for high-current generator excitation systems or relevant electrical systems, with focus on mechanical layout, equipment placement, and bus work installation requirements. Review site installation conditions, panel alignment, bus work fitment, clearances, accessibility, and routing against approved drawings and 3D design models. Provide technical support during installation, assembly, inspection, FAT/SAT, and commissioning activities related to high-current bus work, cabinet layouts, cooling arrangements, and power connections. Identify and resolve mechanical layout, bus work, wiring interface, installation, and manufacturing-related issues while maintaining safety, quality, and schedule commitments. Capture site and manufacturing lessons learned and incorporate them into future layout, bus work, and 3D design improvements. Prepare installation support records, punch lists, issue logs, redline updates, and handover documentation in coordination with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and customer teams. Eight (8) to sixteen (16) years of experience in generator excitation systems, high-current electrical systems, electrical panel design, power electronics, or relevant industrial power equipment. Proven Auto CAD or relevant CAD experience in designing mechanical layouts for high-current electrical systems, preferably in the 5,000 A to 10,000 A range. Mandatory hands-on 3D design experience for equipment layout, bus work arrangement, fitment checks, clearances, routing, accessibility, and manufacturability validation. Strong capability to lead complete high-current bus work design with high accuracy, including routing, dimensional control, joint details, supports, clearances, creepage, thermal considerations, and short-circuit withstand requirements. title: Senior Technical Lead-Generator Excitation Solutions

The position will provide technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, from requirements review and detailed engineering through FAT, site commissioning, troubleshooting, customer handover, and complete program execution for large excitation system projects. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and concept design to hardware/software engineering, simulation, testing, and commissioning. Project Engineering: Lead end-to-end project engineering for high-current static generator excitation systems, from requirements review and concept development through detailed design, manufacturing support, FAT, site installation, and commissioning. Design excitation system electrical and mechanical layouts for high-current applications, typically in the 5,000 A to 10,000 A range, including cubicle arrangement, power circuit configuration, cooling provisions, and maintainability requirements. Perform sizing and selection of excitation system components, including transformers, rectifier bridges, thyristors/diodes, bus bars, disconnecting devices, breakers, protection devices, cooling equipment, controllers, I/O, and auxiliary power supplies. Develop and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, interconnection drawings, general arrangement drawings, BOMs, control logic, system architecture, and network topology documents. Engineer bus work and high-current power connections, including routing, clearance, creepage, thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, and manufacturability considerations. Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and system integrators to ensure the excitation system design is practical, cost-effective, manufacturable, and compliant with project specifications. Support manufacturing quality processes, including inspection plans, assembly reviews, test procedures, nonconformance resolution, and corrective actions for high-current excitation equipment. Implement control logic from SAMA diagrams, functional descriptions, and project-specific operating requirements. Configure and integrate communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850, and DNP3, as applicable. Ensure compliance with applicable IEEE, IEC, NEC, ISO, HSE, and regional grid code requirements. Manage complete project programs for high-current excitation systems, including engineering deliverables, technical risk, schedule alignment, manufacturing readiness, customer reviews, and cross-functional execution. Lead site teams during excitation system installation, panel power-up, redundancy checks, I/O verification, loop checks, device checks, and system energization. Perform and support commissioning of high-current excitation systems, including AVR/FCR control checks, limiters, protection functions, interface testing, and generator performance validation. Troubleshoot issues related to excitation controllers, power bridges, firing circuits, field flashing, cooling systems, communication interfaces, protection devices, and auxiliary systems. Review and resolve installation or wiring deviations, site constraints, and commissioning punch points while maintaining safety and quality requirements. Modify logic, graphics, databases, parameters, and test configurations as required to meet approved customer and site requirements. Ability to interface with vendors & sub-contractors. Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., NEC, IEEE, IEC, OSHA). Willingness to work in industrial environments and adhere to safety protocols. title: Product Compliance Engineer
jobDescription: Position Summary: Emerson is seeking a knowledgeable and detail‑oriented Certification Engineer to join our Engineering team in Pune. In this role, you will work closely with product engineering teams and global certification agencies to ensure products comply with applicable safety and regulatory standards. You will play a critical role in guiding design compliance, managing certifications for ordinary and hazardous location products, and maintaining certification continuity throughout the product lifecycle. title: Senior Tech Lead Mechatronics
jobDescription:
We are seeking a skilled & experienced Sr Tech lead
- Mechatronics domain Engineer to join our dynamic Engineering team. As a Sr Technical Lead, you will collaborate with engineering team for product design & development. You will be responsible for leading complex mechatronics systems involving BLDC, Steeper & Servo motors & provide design guidelines to meet the requirements. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: A Mechatronics Engineer must have solid technical skills in the fields of mechanics, electronics, Electrical and computer science System Architecture & Mechatronic Design: Lead design of complex mechatronic systems involving BLDC, stepper, and servo motors. Architect integrated motion systems combining sensors, actuators, drives, and controllers for industrial machines. Motor Control, Drives & Embedded Software: Specify and optimize DC motor drives and actuator systems for efficiency, thermal performance, and precision. Competence in the use and management of sensors and actuators, PLCs, and embedded systems Develop and tune motion‑control algorithms, PID/FOC loops, and embedded software (C/C++/Python). Modeling, Simulation & Prototyping Use MATLAB/Simulink and CAE tools to model dynamics, NVH, thermal behavior, and system performance. Lead rapid prototyping, testing, root‑cause analysis, and supplier coordination for custom components. Gear Train & Transmission Design Design spur, helical, planetary, and harmonic gear systems for motor-driven mechanisms. Perform gear macro/micro geometry design, backlash/tolerance analysis, and strength/life calculations using AGMA/ISO standards. Knowledge of Ball Screw, lead screw and different Mechanism for Rotary to Linear conversion. Work together with Hydraulic expert to integrate electronics to Actuator systems Motion System Integration Select and size motors, gearboxes, encoders/resolvers, brakes, and drives using load, inertia, and duty-cycle analysis. Define mechanical requirements, architecture, and detailed designs for precision motion assemblies. Understanding of the principles governing automatic control systems, such as control system theory and system modeling Testing, Validation & Reliability Conduct bench testing, torque‑speed characterization, NVH validation, and system debugging. Perform DFMEA, verification planning, design validation, and implement corrective actions. Manufacturing & DFM/DFA Apply DFM/DFA principles and select appropriate materials and processes for gears, shafts, housings, and transmission components. Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Compliance Work closely with electronics, firmware, mechanical, and manufacturing teams across development stages. Ensure compliance with industry safety and regulatory standards (UL, CSA, FM, ISO, IEC, NEC, FDA). Communicate design decisions, risks, and results to global stakeholders. For This Role, You Will Need: Bachelor’s/Master’s in Mechatronics/Mechanical/Electrical or related. Min 15 years in mechatronic design focused on motorized and gear‑based systems. Strong knowledge of BLDC/Stepper motors, drivers, power stages, feedback devices (incremental/absolute encoders, resolvers), and motion control fundamentals. Hands‑on experience with AGMA/ISO gear design and analysis, tolerance analysis, bearing selection and preload, shaft/housing stiffness, and NVH basics. Experience with power analyzers, oscilloscopes, torque/force sensors, accelerometers, spectrum analyzers, and dynamometer test benches. Working knowledge of relevant ISO, IEC & UL/CE standards. Excellent problem-solving, Critical thinking and debugging skills. Strong communication and collaboration skills.

title: Tech Lead Firmware
jobDescription: We are seeking a skilled Technical Leader – Firmware to join our dynamic Engineering team. This role is part of the Engineering & Design team and focuses on embedded firmware development for Industrial Automation products, particularly Electric Actuators. The position requires strong hands on skills in embedded C programming, real time firmware development, system integration, debugging, and embedded architecture design. The candidate will independently drive firmware development activities and collaborate closely with cross functional teams. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Work on Embedded Firmware projects as a member of Engineering & Design team for new product development and lead the development of firmware for Industrial Automation products such as Electric Actuators. Define and document embedded system architecture, requirements, and software specifications. Demonstrate a hands-on technical background, excellent C programming and embedded code in compliance with coding standards and best practices Develop and maintain low-level drivers, communication stacks, and real-time control algorithms for electric actuators. Lead code reviews, unit testing, and system-level integration testing to ensure reliability and compliance with safety standards. Support regulatory and compliance testing focused on embedded software contributions (functional safety, EMC, etc.). Evaluate new processors, RTOS platforms, and development tools to enhance product performance and maintainability. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including hardware & mechanical engineers, to ensure cohesive and integrated product development. Develop Product domain knowledge, conduct and participate in team meetings and knowledge sharing sessions. Report & communicate project progress to stakeholders periodically. Independently own and drive firmware development activities. Provide technical guidance to junior engineers when required, particularly in debugging and design quality. For This Role, You Will Need: Bachelor’s or Masters degree in Electrical / Electronics / Telecommunication / Computer Engineering. 12+ years of professional work experience in embedded firmware development Proficiency in C/C++ for real-time embedded systems. Experience with microcontrollers, RTOS, and embedded development tool chains. Experience integrating with hardware at the driver level (sensors, ADC/DAC, communication interfaces, etc.). Practical embedded software design skills with 16/32-bit Microcontroller based design. Experience with I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, RS232/485 Communication Interfaces & Protocol. Excellent understanding of Embedded design life cycle & new product development process. Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting on embedded targets using test & measurement equipment like Digital Oscilloscope, Protocol Analyzer etc. Knowledge and experience with distributed version control (such as GIT) and continuous integration. Ability to independently lead complex firmware activities and make technical decisions with minimal guidance. Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills. Strong communication and collaboration skills. A willingness to learn. Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: Experience of working with global teams. Experience of developing firmware for electric actuators. Knowledge & experience with industrial digital communication protocols (e.g. HART, Modbus, Ethernet, Profibus, Profinet, BLE, Lo Ra WAN etc.) Familiarity with functional safety standards (e.g. IEC61508). Experience with low-power embedded systems and battery management. Knowledge of electrical safety, EMC, and regulatory compliance standards as applied to embedded systems. Knowledge of Control Loop Theory and Stability. Proficiency with scripting languages (e.g., Python) for test automation. Strong problem solving and debugging skills across both lab and field environments. Experience with STM32 series microcontroller will be advantage. Experience of Unit and Integration testing, performance measurement, Debugging and analysis of the assigned issues, Re-engineering of existing code for reuse with required modifications and associated unit/integration testing. Experience contributing to firmware architecture or reusable platform components is a plus. jobDescription: The Application Support Team in FCEC has traditionally been responsible for the development & support of Flow Controls’ CPQ (Configure Price Quote) applications – FF2, FSM, PQT and Presto. Application Engineers and Emerson Impact Partners around the world use these applications to Size, Select, Quote, and Order Fisher and Regulator products. While this team still supports these critical applications, our focus has changed to creating next generation applications. By joining this team, you will be effectively contributing to the development of Presto (our Next Generation CPQ cloud tool) and Phoenix (our overall digital transformation program). title: Product Design Engineer
jobDescription: Position Summary: The Mechanical Design Engineer (NPD & Sustenance) plays a key role in developing, improving, and sustaining mechanical products across their lifecycle. This position focuses on concept development, detailed design, and continuous improvement while applying design‑for‑manufacturing principles, cost optimization, and quality excellence. The role collaborates closely with cross‑functional and global teams to deliver reliable, high‑quality, and manufacturable solutions that meet customer and business needs. Position Summary: The Mechanical Design Engineer (NPD & Sustenance) plays a key role in developing, improving, and sustaining mechanical products across their lifecycle. This position focuses on concept development, detailed design, and continuous improvement while applying design‑for‑manufacturing principles, cost optimization, and quality excellence. The role collaborates closely with cross‑functional and global teams to deliver reliable, high‑quality, and manufacturable solutions that meet customer and business needs. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Generate ideas, develop concepts, and create detailed mechanical designs for new products and product enhancements. Perform hand calculations, tolerance analysis, and GD&T stack‑up in alignment with ASME Y14.5 standards. Apply strong engineering fundamentals to address design, manufacturing, and performance challenges. Provide CAD design support using Solid Edge or Solid Works for New Product Development (NPD) and Sustenance projects. Drive cost‑reduction and quality improvement initiatives while maintaining product performance and compliance. Apply Design for Manufacturability and Assembly (DFMA) principles to improve efficiency and ease of production. Execute Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) and Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) using PLM systems. Support prototype build, functional testing, validation activities, and evaluation of test results. Create, manage, and maintain costed Bills of Materials (BOMs) using Teamcenter or similar PLM tools. Balance multiple priorities effectively to meet customer expectations, quality requirements, and project timelines. Communicate technical information, design intent, and project updates clearly with global and cross‑functional stakeholders. Who You Are: You build effective relationships across teams, functions, and geographies by communicating clearly and respectfully. You approach challenges with curiosity and a structured problem‑solving mindset, continuously seeking opportunities to learn and improve. You collaborate openly with partners such as Electronics Hardware, Firmware, Manufacturing, and Sourcing teams to achieve shared goals. You take ownership of your work, stay focused on results, and follow through on commitments to deliver high‑quality outcomes. For This Role, You Will Need: A bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Experience in mechanical design, product development, or sustenance engineering roles. Working knowledge of CAD tools, with preference for Solid Edge; experience with Solid Works is also valued. Understanding of casting, plastic, and/or forging design considerations. Familiarity with GD&T concepts and ASME Y14.5 standards. Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly in both written and verbal formats for a global audience. Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and processes in a dynamic environment. Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline. Experience working in structured NPD environments with PLM systems such as Teamcenter. Exposure to appliance or consumer product design. Demonstrated experience contributing to cost, quality, or manufacturability improvements. Our Culture and Commitment To You: At Emerson, we foster an inclusive and respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and encouraged. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone can grow, contribute, and do meaningful work. We support continuous learning, collaboration, and innovation, and we strive to provide opportunities that help our people thrive professionally and personally. Emerson is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. #LI-CS1

title: Lead Engineer – Cloud Application Security
jobDescription: Position Summary: As part of Emerson’s Cross Portfolio, Technology, and Innovation (CPTI) team within Measurement Solutions, the Lead Engineer – Cloud Application Security Architect plays a critical role in strengthening the security of Emerson’s cloud-based software platforms, including Plantweb™ Cloud initiatives. This role focuses on application security architecture, threat modeling, secure design and code review, and close collaboration with global development and cybersecurity teams. You will help shape secure, scalable cloud solutions that support Emerson’s customers across industries worldwide—while enjoying the stability of a Fortune 500 organization and the challenge of working within a diverse, international, and matrixed environment. This role offers flexibility through a hybrid work model, enabling you to work remotely one day per week while collaborating in person with highly motivated colleagues who are passionate about delivering secure, award‑winning technology. Position Summary: As part of Emerson’s Cross Portfolio, Technology, and Innovation (CPTI) team within Measurement Solutions, the Lead Engineer – Cloud Application Security Architect plays a critical role in strengthening the security of Emerson’s cloud-based software platforms, including Plantweb™ Cloud initiatives. This role focuses on application security architecture, threat modeling, secure design and code review, and close collaboration with global development and cybersecurity teams. You will help shape secure, scalable cloud solutions that support Emerson’s customers across industries worldwide—while enjoying the stability of a Fortune 500 organization and the challenge of working within a diverse, international, and matrixed environment. This role offers flexibility through a hybrid work model, enabling you to work remotely one day per week while collaborating in person with highly motivated colleagues who are passionate about delivering secure, award‑winning technology. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: • Review and analyze UML diagrams, data flow diagrams, and threat models to identify security risks and recommend practical mitigations • Guide and mentor development teams on secure design principles and secure coding practices • Facilitate engaging security awareness sessions and workshops for developers, architects, and leaders • Review requirements and source code to identify and address application‑level security vulnerabilities • Define and influence security requirements for cloud‑based software platforms and services • Collaborate with internal cybersecurity teams across business units, geographies, and organizational levels, as well as with external partners • Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud security processes while supporting compliance with IEC 62443‑3‑3, IEC 62443‑4‑1, CSA, and NIS2 requirements • Participate in internal and external audits and standards‑based assessments • Perform hands‑on coding when needed to support security objectives and proof‑of‑concept solutions • Support cybersecurity documentation and review activities, including EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) compliance for cloud platforms Who You Are: You build trust through open collaboration and value diverse perspectives when solving complex problems. You translate complex security concepts into clear, actionable guidance that helps teams make confident decisions. You take initiative, continuously seek to improve how security is embedded into development practices, and remain adaptable in a fast‑evolving technology landscape. You are energized by mentoring others and contributing to secure outcomes that have real‑world impact. For This Role, You Will Need: • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience • Demonstrated hands‑on professional coding experience, ideally within cloud‑based environments • Strong experience with secure software development lifecycle practices and application security design principles • Practical experience performing application‑level threat modeling and secure code reviews • Working knowledge of cryptography concepts, including PKI and certificate management • Awareness of current malware trends and emerging cybersecurity threats • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: • Experience in industrial, automotive, or operational technology (OT) environments such as ICS or SCADA • Cloud security or architecture certifications (for example, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer or Cybersecurity Architect certifications, or equivalent) • Experience working with cloud‑native technology stacks and modern application architectures • Exposure to Dev Sec Ops practices and CI/CD automation within active production platforms • Familiarity with EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) requirements, IEC 62443 standards, CSA guidance, and NIS2 Our Culture and Commitment To You: At Emerson, we believe innovation thrives when people feel included, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We offer flexible work arrangements, meaningful career development opportunities, and the chance to contribute to technologies that make the world safer, smarter, and more sustainable. title: AI Agent Development Engineer
jobDescription: We are seeking an AI Agent Development Engineer with strong expertise in power plant process operations and control systems (preferably Ovation DCS). The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who combines deep domain knowledge with practical skills in AI, machine learning, data science, and Python programming to design, build, test, and deploy intelligent AI agents for industrial automation and decision support. This role is focused on direct development and technical execution, owning the complete AI agent development lifecycle, from understanding plant operations and data to agent design, implementation, validation, and deployment in real power plant environments. In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: In this role, you will help shape the future of intelligent engineering and power plant operations by developing hands-on AI/ML and agent-based solutions that simplify engineering work, increase productivity, and unlock new operational capabilities. You will build intelligent tools and AI agents that automate control logic generation, graphics configuration, reporting, and engineering workflows, enabling plant engineers to focus on higher-value innovation. By analyzing control system and operational data, you will uncover patterns, develop predictive capabilities, and deliver data-driven decision support for real-world power plant environments. Apply AI-based anomaly detection, diagnostics, and decision-support solutions to real power-plant operational challenges. Translate plant operating behavior, control logic, alarms, and historian trends into practical AI use cases and agent workflows. Work with time-series operational data from DCS/SCADA and plant historians (preferably Emerson Ovation) to identify abnormal patterns, degradation, and performance losses. Collaborate with sales and marketing, and reliability teams to validate AI insights against real plant conditions. Support development and tuning of AI/analytics models using Python and data tools (focus on application rather than algorithm research). Integrate AI outputs into dashboards, alerts, and engineering workflows without impacting plant safety or control integrity. Test, validate, and monitor AI solutions in live or near-real plant environments, ensuring reliability and low false-alarm rates. Continuously improve AI performance using operational feedback, historical fault data, and domain knowledge. Troubleshoot deployed analytics/AI tools and coordinate improvements with software or data teams. Who you Are: We are looking for a proactive professional who excels in dynamic, fast-paced environments. You demonstrate exceptional initiative, confidently tackling complex challenges in power plant control and optimization. With a strong commitment to innovation and excellence, you set ambitious goals and uphold the highest standards in every project. For This Role, You Will Need: Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Control Systems, Power Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 2–8 years of experience in coal-fired, combined-cycle, or utility power plants with strong knowledge of plant operations, control processes, and performance optimization. Hands-on experience with DCS platforms, preferably Emerson Ovation, including control logic, alarm management, plant monitoring, and troubleshooting. Strong understanding of power plant systems such as boilers, turbines, generators, combustion controls, and balance-of-plant operations. Experience developing AI-powered applications using Python, including data processing, API integration, and workflow automation. Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI Agent frameworks such as Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Crew AI, or similar. Ability to translate power plant operational knowledge and procedures into AI Agent use cases and intelligent automation solutions. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across operations, engineering, and software development teams. Preferred Qualifications That Make You Stand Out: Experience with Emerson Ovation DCS or other power plant control systems (ABB, Honeywell, Siemens, GE, Yokogawa). Hands-on experience developing AI Agents, operator assistants, troubleshooting tools, or knowledge management solutions for industrial applications. Knowledge of machine learning, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and time-series analytics. Familiarity with vector databases, cloud AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and industrial data integration. Passion for applying AI and automation technologies to improve power plant operations, reliability, and performance. title: Gas Turbine Controls Engineer
jobDescription: The candidate will be an essential member of a team-oriented Gas Turbine Solutions Group with responsibilities for hardware & software design, logic implementation, testing and deployment of gas turbine control retrofit systems. Duties require experience with Siemens/ABB-Alstom/Westinghouse/General Electric heavy-duty combustion turbine controls. Experience with Pratt & Whitney/GE/Rolls Royce aero-derivative gas turbine control systems is welcomed. Candidate shall be self-motivated and possess effective skills for communicating with internal and external customers. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Project Engineering: Execute Hardware & Software Controls engineering. Implement the Ovation control logic and graphics for the Gas Turbine control system. Develop & test closed loops, open loops and protection loops for GT. Technical evaluation of bid for specifications. Develop/review Bill of materials, network architecture, GA drawings Technically support vendor selection. Test, verify and document using Gas Turbine Simulator that the Ovation control system performs to specification. Develop the narrative control document describing the gas turbine unit operation and its associated alarms and trips. Conduct the Hardware & Software Design Review (SDR) and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) with the customer. Provide Installation and Commissioning Support to field service team. Provide post-Installation Customer Service Support. Participate in project internal and customer Kick of Meeting (KOM) Co-ordinate with US lead engineer for design/implementation of control and graphics Track project budget, progress & quality of the projects and ensure periodic reporting to front offices. Field Services: Preparing site execution plans with help of project manager Leading the site team for Ovation system power up, redundancy and I/O testing Maintaining protocols for loop check, device check and panel charging Leading the site team for Analog and Binary Device testing and fault finding Engaging with customers and vendors on technical aspects of site commissioning and report the progress and flags the roadblocks and challenges to site manager or project manager. Fault diagnosis of Ovation system, network system, and various communication interfaces like OPC, Modbus, DNP3, serial etc. Loop and device checking and necessary modifications in the logics, graphics, and database as per customer /site requirements Working closely with engineering team for troubleshooting of HW/SW (e.g. controllers, modules, link modules etc.) Commissioning for commercial operation. Customer facing and preparation of site report. Coordination with vendors and front offices. Who You Are : You should be able to assume responsibility for the outcomes of others. Promotes a sense of urgency and establishes and enforces individual accountability in the team. You should be able to deliver messages in a clear, compelling, and concise manner. Actively listens and checks for understanding. Sets aggressive goals and has high standards. You should be consistently one of the top performers. Pursues everything with energy, drive, and the need to finish as per business needs. For This Role, You Will Need: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Control & Instrumentation, power or Electronics / Electrical engineering. Minimum 5 years of experience in Gas Turbine Control System hardware and software development, implementation, testing and validation. Experience working for a major turbine manufacturer or turbine controls vendor (e.g. GE, Siemens, Westinghouse, ABB, Alstom, Mitsubishi, Hitachi, Toshiba, etc.). Gas Turbine control algorithm knowledge (e.g. Fuel Governor, Sequencing and Auxiliaries, AGC, Isochronous and Droop controls etc.). Experience with ISA and SAMA logic symbols, Process & Instrumentation Diagrams. Proficiency with configuring database, logic and HMIs of one or more DCS platforms (e.g. Emerson Ovation, ABB/Bailey INFI 90, Siemens T3000, GE Mark V/ VI, Mitsubishi DIASYS Netmation, Invensys, Woodward Micronet etc.). Gas Turbine process knowledge. Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form. Advanced troubleshooting, problem-solving, decision-making, and planning skills. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients and customers. Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Ability and willingness to travel as may be required Ability to influence others and lead small teams Experience with electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic schematics. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and technical documents. title: Data Strategy Manager
jobDescription: The Data Strategy Manager will serve a key role in the Flow Controls Business Intelligence and application development strategy from a data knowledgebase, business engagement, prioritization, and development facilitation perspective, in order to serve business analytics and application data needs. Job Summary The Data Strategy Manager will serve a key role in the Flow Controls Business Intelligence and application development strategy from a data knowledgebase, business engagement, prioritization, and development facilitation perspective, in order to serve business analytics and application data needs. They will be responsible for developing strategy and managing the “grey area” between business analysts who don’t speak relational databases, and Power BI and App Developers who aren’t as familiar with business processes and needs. The role will require someone who enjoys analytics and research, is organized, and sees the value in documentation such as Data Catalogs, and who feels that Data Quality and good stewardship are worthy endeavors. They should be equally comfortable discussing EDW/ETL strategy with Power BI teams and interfacing with business teams in an advisory and requirements gathering role. They will also be capable of designing and facilitating development of data solutions in the Azure and SQL Server ecosystems by ensuring quality requirements gathering, prioritization, and development execution by overseeing sprints, standups, and developer workflow. The Data Strategy Manager gives input into the overall relational database strategy, owns the documentation around the various environments’ data flows, and as knowledge grows, develops the informational repository which will serve as a central resource for the how, where, why, and when, from a data perspective. The PBI / RDBMS strategy, infrastructure, and technical staff work as a program to support Flow Controls (Fisher) North America manufacturing locations, corporate offices, as well as globally used EDW databases and systems. The Data Strategy Manager is a member of the Global Business Systems IT group. Essential Job Functions: Curate, document, and integrate knowledge about the various data sources, flows, and consumption of critical Flow Controls business data systems. Advise and liaise to various business and IT teams about the source, nature, availability, and value of various data sets. Manage the EDW developers on how this data needs to be transformed, packaged, and delivered to the business community. Act as a focal to the Flow Controls business community to support their business data needs. Work with business to determine reporting / data analysis needs, identifying opportunities for local processes to be used regionally / globally, or inversely to educate users on already existing solutions that already meet their needs. Work with DW architects / developers to determine data sources for reporting or request new projects for obtaining missing data and participate in project execution representing the needs of both business and IT communities. Make recommendation on where to embed business logic, either in the ETL, views, or reporting layer. Support business users / analysts and Intelligent Automation teams to identify proper sources for localized reporting and processes. Monitoring data access patterns and user opinions to highlight opportunities for improvement in the user experience. Be familiar with and provide input on optimum data delivery and assembly options: Views. Materialized views / data tables. Scheduled (snapshot) reporting. Maintain a comprehensive data catalog / dictionary for business user / ad-hoc user, IT analyst, developer, and management consumption. Serve as a liaison between data consumers (business users) and Power BI / EDW developers in other orgs. Direct work for Enterprise IT and other contract and project resources as needed through Agile methodologies (requirements definitions, user stories, backlog grooming, standups, etc.) Identify, prioritize, and manage internal “must-do” projects (life cycle replacement, etc.) and business initiatives. Steer all projects toward policy compliance, adherence to standards, cost containment, and value, while guiding the business towards realistic expectations of performance, uptime, and risk. Relationship management of the various RDBMS vendors & support tool vendors (Microsoft, Red Gate, Quest, etc.) Education / Experience Required: BS/BA degree plus 8-10 years’ experience 3+ years managing people Experience with relational database and reporting services and teams in a corporate environment Experience with an Enterprise class data center and cloud computing Knowledge / Skills / Abilities: Some strategic and technical expertise of relational database systems and at least one end user reporting platform (Power BI, Cognos, Noetix, etc.) Comfortable exploring, reviewing, and interpreting TSQL, relational database table structure, views, and stored procedures. Basic familiarity with supporting enterprise class systems: server hardware, OS, SAN, networking, firewalls, Active Directory, virtualization, and cloud implementation, understanding the role these play in the EDW / PBI experience Some TSQL development experience Good interpersonal and written skills Good presentation and communication skills Good planning skills Ability to liaise with and influence corporate shared services teams Ability to negotiate system downtime and delivery timelines with business stakeholders Ability to communicate in business language Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities Ability to remain flexible and professional while under pressure Resource and project management within the data ecosystem Manage enterprise risk from an infrastructure, security, data loss, and downtime perspective Conflict management Bonus Skills: ERP exposure, especially within a manufacturing business SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) development Advanced TSQL development Power BI / SSRS Report development Data Warehousing exposure and methodologies Understanding data sources / types Designing Data Marts Recommending EDW Architecture changes Experience with documentation and information sharing systems such as Wikis, Confluence, Share Point, Red Gate SQL Doc, or similar. Azure or other cloud experience (Azure Dev Ops, Data Factory, Synapse, etc.) Work Environment / Conditions: Normal office environment, voluntary hybrid work model available. Physical Locations: Marshalltown, IA or Sherman, TX Physical Demands: Ability to work at computer for extended periods of time. Occasional travel required. title: Project Lead Engineer- EMS/PPC/MPPC Controls -Solar-BESS-Wind-Hybrid
jobDescription: This job involves control system engineering for Solar, BESS, Wind and Hybrid Renewables Projects. You will be involved in collection of inputs, customer meetings, design concept, engineering/implementation, process simulation & testing based upon customer requirements. You will be responsible for complete Project Life Cycle i.e. starting from inputs analysis, Design & Engineering, Testing & Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) followed by commissioning as per requirement In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: You will be responsible for complete Project Life Cycle i.e. starting from inputs analysis, Design & Engineering, Testing & Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) followed by commissioning for PPC/MPPC control as per requirement. Project Engineering: Execution of with PSCAD, PSSE, Digsilent modeling along with suppliers and providing adequate inputs and review of these models and ability to read electrical single-line diagrams (SLDs) Should be able to do process testing, tuning of Solar/BESS/Hybrid plants PPC controls, working knowledge of industrial standards like IEEE, IEC, NEC, and Grid codes Collection and review of project inputs from the Front Office or from the customer site through e-mail, kick off meeting, site survey. Lead Ovation controls and Ovation Green SCADA based Solar/BESS/Wind greenfield and retrofit projects, Software and hardware engineering and configuration Guiding team to implement controls from, functional diagrams or functional descriptions and doing Tie back simulation testing; modifications of control Logics/SCADA. Configuration on 3 rd party protocols, ELC and SLC communication. Preparation and guiding the team on IO list, Datasets and DBID. Distributing the engineering work to system integrators, Participation in kick-off meetings (KOM), internal and external meetings of projects; Engagement in customer demos, FATs, SATs, and commissioning activities Working closely with Ovation Green product team and work on Matlab, PPC, Java script. Ovation system setup, redundancy and I/O testing; Analogue and digital device testing and fault finding at site during commissioning. Fault diagnosis of Ovation system, network system, and various communication interfaces like OPC, Modbus, DNP3, serial, IEC 61850, etc during remote/site commissioning. Solar/BESS/Wind/Hybrid plant commissioning for commercial operation; Travel to project sites for site assignments, testing and tuning of various electrical control functions, for third-party communication. Who You Are: You should be able to assume responsibility for the outcomes of others . Promotes a sense of urgency and establishes and enforces individual accountability in the team. You should be able to deliver messages in a clear, compelling, and concise manner. Actively listens and checks for understanding. Sets aggressive goals and has high standards. You should be consistently one of the top performers. Pursues everything with energy, drive, and the need to finish as per business needs. For This Role, You Will Need: Degree in Engineering ( Electrical, Electronics, Power Engineering ) Seven (7) to ten (10) years of experience in DCS/PLC programming / Engineering & commissioning of PPC/MPPC/EMS Ability to troubleshoot DCS/PLC control system Excellent language and communication skills; both verbal and written Ability to travel for 30 to 50% as per the job requirements Ability to effectively present information and respond to queries from groups of managers, clients, and customers Ability to interface with vendors & sub-contractors Should have good understanding of safety tools and gears, and safety guidelines of working at site Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: Good knowledge of Solar, BESS power plant process and KPI’s Knowledge of electrical equipment like switchboards, generators, turbines, AVRs, motors, transformers, capacitors, CTs, VTs, feeders, meters, relays Knowledge in C programming, Matlab,Java script, SQL Our Culture & Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. Adherence to standard processes for code development, secure coding, reuse, and portability. Drive code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability for self and others in the team. Troubleshooting and performing Root Cause Analysis of the issues. Maintain documentation, bug tracking, and records related to firmware development. Manage the product backlog, define product requirements and User Stories. Facilitate sprint planning, track sprint progress, and manage stakeholder communication. Lead a small team of developers and test engineers, and mentor team members to remove the impediments to help them progress Lead firmware development projects, including planning, scheduling, and coordinating with other team members to meet project deadlines. Proficiency in programming languages such as C/C++ for embedded systems. Experience with implementing industrial protocols such as HART, Modbus, Profibus, FF, etc. Low level firmware development for peripherals like Ethernet/USB/I2C/SPI/UART/Display etc. Working experience in developing product with Cybersecurity as per IEC62443 Experience developing firmware based on RTOS. Familiarity with IEC 61508 and SIL2 level firmware development Familiarity with European Union Cyber Resilience Act Communication Protocols –Bluetooth, Modbus TCP/IP, Ethernet/IP will be advantageous. Experience working in a global engineering environment. Agile software delivery using Azure Dev Ops and Microsoft Team Foundation Server. Prior experience in the industrial automation or control systems industry. Competencies Tech Savvy Collaborates Customer Focus Drives Results .

title: Performance Optimization Engineer
jobDescription:
We are seeking an Advanced Control Engineer with expertise in PID tuning, boiler tuning, model predictive control (MPC), multivariable control, fuzzy logic control, and power plant DCS commissioning. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in steam turbine and gas turbine (GT) control, steam temperature optimization, combustion optimization, unit rate optimization, drum level control, and Emerson Ovation DCS commissioning. This role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing advanced control strategies to enhance the performance, efficiency, and reliability of power plants and industrial processes. In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Boiler & Turbine Control Excellence – Innovate and optimize PID loops for combustion, drum level, and feedwater control, ensuring seamless and highly efficient turbine performance with intelligent load-sharing strategies. Improve Steam Temperature Control
- Implement new control strategies, such as spray attemperation and reheater tuning, to maintain efficient steam conditions, minimize thermal stress, and increase plant longevity. Advanced Combustion Optimization – Drive efficiency by fine-tuning air-fuel ratios, enhancing emissions control, and optimizing burner management systems for superior heat rate and flame stability. Improving Unit Rate & Load Optimization – Developing smart load demand control strategies, fine-tuning heat rate optimization, and improving turbine governor tuning to increase fuel efficiency and grid stability. Reliable Drum Level & Feedwater Control – Engineer multi-element drum level controls with adaptive tuning, ensuring outstanding stability under fluctuating load conditions while minimizing shrink and swell effects. Implement brand new MPC strategies to minimize process variability, improve system stability, and seamlessly integrate with advanced DCS/PLC systems. DCS Commissioning (Emerson Ovation) – Lead with expertise in configuring, programming, and commissioning DCS, optimizing plant performance, and ensuring smooth power plant operations. Innovative Fuzzy Logic & Advanced Control – Harness intelligent control solutions, integrating fuzzy logic with PID and MPC for unparalleled efficiency, adaptability, and process excellence. Data-Driven Process Optimization & Performance Enhancement – Analyze critical operational data to identify growth opportunities, drive efficiency, and collaborate with plant teams to ensure a future-ready power plant. Who you Are: We are looking for a proactive professional who excels in dynamic, fast-paced environments. You demonstrate exceptional initiative, confidently tackling complex challenges in power plant control and optimization. With a strong commitment to innovation and excellence, you set ambitious goals and uphold the highest standards in every project. For This Role, You Will Need: A Bachelor’s / Master’s or equivalent experience in Instrumentation and Control Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field. 5-15+ years of hands-on experience in power plant control, process automation, and advanced control strategies, driving efficiency and innovation. Preferred Qualifications That Make You Stand Out: Deep expertise in control system engineering, power plant automation, and turbine control, enabling seamless process optimization. Proven proficiency in PID tuning, boiler tuning, and process modeling, ensuring maximum efficiency and reliability. Extensive hands-on experience in Emerson Ovation DCS commissioning and fixing, driving seamless plant operations. Mastery of Model Predictive Control (MPC), multivariable control, and fuzzy logic control, enhancing automation and performance. Strong background in steam temperature optimization, combustion optimization, and unit rate optimization, leading to greater energy efficiency. title: Lead Engineer – Vibration
jobDescription: Position Summary: The Lead Engineer – Vibration / HALT is responsible for leading and managing environmental testing activities with a focus on vibration and HALT/HASS testing. This role ensures compliance with NABL (ISO/IEC 17025) requirements while driving planning, execution, supervision, and quality assurance of lab testing services. The role also emphasizes strong technical expertise, team leadership, customer engagement, and continuous improvement in testing processes and laboratory operations. Position Summary: The Lead Engineer – Vibration / HALT is responsible for leading and managing environmental testing activities with a focus on vibration and HALT/HASS testing. This role ensures compliance with NABL (ISO/IEC 17025) requirements while driving planning, execution, supervision, and quality assurance of lab testing services. The role also emphasizes strong technical expertise, team leadership, customer engagement, and continuous improvement in testing processes and laboratory operations. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Ensure compliance with ISO/IEC 17025 and NABL accreditation requirements Prepare and maintain SOPs, test methods, calibration and traceability records, and measurement uncertainty evaluations Participate in internal and external audits and proficiency testing programs; address audit observations and implement corrective actions Oversee preventive and breakdown maintenance of lab equipment and ensure timely calibration with traceability to national/international standards Coordinate with vendors for equipment upgrades, maintenance, and AMC support Engage with customers for technical discussions, clarifications, and test requirement reviews Provide technical inputs for proposals and ensure timely delivery of accurate test reports Lead, mentor, and train engineers and technicians; drive capability development and adherence to safety practices Execute laboratory quality activities such as ILC and PT programs Lead vibration testing (sine, random, shock, transportation simulation) and HALT/HASS testing programs Develop, review, and approve test procedures, plans, and work instructions Interpret international standards such as IEC, MIL, ASTM, ISO, and JSS, along with customer specifications Ensure appropriate test setup, instrumentation selection, and fixture design Provide technical leadership in failure analysis and root cause investigations Evaluate test results and generate technically sound reports Plan and manage workload, manpower, and testing schedules Ensure optimal utilization and uptime of lab equipment including shakers, chambers, and controllers Who You Are: You make sound, informed decisions by analyzing complex technical data and evaluating multiple factors under demanding conditions. You build strong, collaborative relationships and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels. You develop and motivate others by providing guidance, mentorship, and opportunities for growth. You continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, enhance efficiency, and deliver high-quality outcomes with a strong focus on safety and compliance.
